gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-mayan-num: Expressive and bold, Autour One draws round letters with a clear channel leading in. Noto Sans Mayan Numerals follows in a tall-bodied sans whose gaping c stays visible at any size, so a longer read feels open rather than crowded.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-medefaidr: Round, loud and unfussy: Autour One has an o whose sides and top match in thickness. Noto Sans Medefaidrin rises high in the lowercase and never lets ink pool where curves turn, so paragraphs keep moving smoothly.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-meetei-ma: Noto Sans Meetei Mayek reads with rounds that gap like a cracked bangle and large lowercase eyes. Autour One sits above it with signage-like plainness in every line weight, a bold display voice against that lighter, modern sans-serif text.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-mende-kik: Noto Sans Mende Kikakui lets daylight through every curved opening, with a lowercase that stands tall against its capitals. Autour One's single stroke width is the sharper contrast.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Autour One is expressive and bold, built from one thin-free, swell-free stroke. Noto Sans Meroitic offers the sharpest quality here: approachable sans-serif lowercase that fills the line almost like capitals, with openings you can see through.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-modi: Noto Sans Modi keeps visible daylight inside every curve and a small step from capital height to body height. Noto Sans Modi sits under Autour One's uniform strokes, which show no difference between upstrokes and sidestrokes, so heading and text feel cut from one tidy system.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-mono: Contemporary and sturdy, Autour One has strokes like a ballpoint pen's. Noto Sans Mono matches it with generously spaced, tall lowercase that never bumps together, and that sturdy, open spacing is the pair's greatest strength.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-mro: Noto Sans Mro reads dense and tall through the middle of each word, with large entrances into every letter's inner space. Autour One's bent-tubing loops sit above it nicely.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-multani: Autour One carries stroke ends that look cut from one ribbon, bold and expressive in a display size. Noto Sans Multani, with its lofty x-height and wide-gapped e, would sit comfortably a size or two smaller.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Noto Sans Myanmar forms a thick, heavy-looking strip of text through the middle, with a c that opens broadly and welcomingly. Autour One is best as monoline display; the body is best at steady reading.
